About Me

Hi, I’m Prativa Kumari Khaan Tharu

A graphic designer delivering bold, clean, and impactful visuals that elevate brands and attract attention.

Design is my medium — where I channel my passion and expertise to explore creative thinking and solve problems. Over the past 4+ years I’ve helped 40+ brands shape how they look and show up, from a first logo concept to a full identity, social feed and short-form video.

4+years

What I do

  1. 01Logo DesignDistinctive marks built to be recognised at a glance.
  2. 02Brand IdentityComplete visual systems — colour, type and guidelines that hold together.
  3. 03Social Media DesignOn-brand templates and posts that keep every feed consistent.
  4. 04Motion & ReelsReel and promo edits with sound design that stop the scroll.
  5. 05Print DesignBrochures, banners, stickers, standees, posters, menus, packaging and business cards.
